sampling: whole pinned subsets, then trimmed to a per-stratum quota; nothing is drawn, so there is still no sampling seed — see `trim`

scoring.aggregate: mean accuracy over the pooled problems across runs

sources.attribution: MATH-500 problems from Hendrycks et al., 'Measuring Mathematical Problem Solving With the MATH Dataset' (MIT license), level-5 subset via HuggingFaceH4/MATH-500.
AIME 2024 problems are American Invitational Mathematics Examination material (Mathematical Association of America), obtained via HuggingFaceH4/aime_2024, whose dataset card declares no license.

trim.reason: the visible practice set was reduced to roughly one third; the hidden set is unchanged, and a subset of the original draw cannot overlap it
trim.rule: round-robin over the draw's strata, in item-file order, until the target is reached
trim.strata: dataset x answer format — the math track draws nothing, so the trim stratifies on the only structure the pinned subsets carry
